chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a Muslim man marrying a Magian woman.
He said: No. But if he has a Magian bondwoman, then there is no harm in having relations with her, practicing withdrawal from her, and not seeking her child.

key_terms.الْمُسْلِمِ: a Muslim man, the subject of the ruling
key_terms.يَطَأَهَا: to have sexual relations with her

ai.seo_question: Can a Muslim man marry a Magian woman according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on marriage and relations with a Magian woman. It forbids a Muslim man from marrying a Magian woman, while permitting relations with a Magian bondwoman under the condition of withdrawal and without seeking offspring from her.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4423 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as).
He said: I asked Imam (as) about a Muslim man marrying a Magian (Zoroastrian) woman.
Imam (as) replied: "No, but if he has a Magian bondwoman, then there is no harm in having relations with her while practicing withdrawal, and he should not seek to have a child with her."
